name: JG_FSCL_DOC_ASSET_XFER_ALL_INT
description: This table contains transaction details that support creation of a Oracle Fusion Receivables invoice that represents the transfer of asset from one location to another, and requires fiscal document generation.

columns.name: FSCL_DOC_ASSET_XFER_ID
columns.description: Fixed assets transfer record identifier.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal Entity identifier of the asset from where it be being transferred.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Party number of the Legal entity from where the asset is being transferred.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LEGAL_REPORTING_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Legal reporting unit identifier that is associated with the source location from where the asset is transferred.

columns.name: LEGAL_REP_UNIT_PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Legal reporting unit party number that is associated with the source location from where the asset is transferred.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code. Use the Manage Currencies task to identify a valid values. Use the three character ISO currency code. Example: US Dollars is USD.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Transaction header details identifier associated with fixed asset transfer transaction record.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique asset book identification name.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number assigned to the asset.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Transaction type identifier used for creating the receivables invoice.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: Transaction type name used for creating the receivables invoice.

columns.name: TERM_ID
columns.description: Payment term identifier. Use the Manage Receivables Payment Terms task to find valid values. Do not use for credit memos or on-account credits.

columns.name: BATCH_SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: Transaction source name used for creating the receivables invoice.

columns.name: BILL_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Bill to customer account number used for creating receivables invoice. Use the Manage Customers task pane from the Billing work area to identify valid values.

columns.name: BILL_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Bill to customer account identifier used for creating receivables invoice. Use the Manage Customers task pane from the Billing work area to identify valid values.

columns.name: BILL_CUSTOMER_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Bill to customer site identifier used for creating receivables invoice. Use the Manage Customers task pane from the Billing work area to identify valid values.

columns.name: BILL_CUSTOMER_SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Bill to customer site number used for creating receivables invoice. Use the Manage Customers task pane from the Billing work area to identify valid values.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_QUANTITY
columns.description: Fixed asset quantity that is transferred from one location to another.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_DATE
columns.description: Date of the fixed asset transfer.

columns.name: UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: Indicative price of each asset that is transferred. This is derived by dividing the net asset cost by the quantity transferred. Use: period (.) or comma (,) as decimal separator.

columns.name: LINE_AMT
columns.description: Indicative net book value of the asset being transferred. Use: period (.) or comma (,) as decimal separator.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of invoice line that is used. Valid values: LINE, TAX, FREIGHT, and CHARGES.

columns.name: REFERENCE_LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Indicates the request ID of the Oracle Fusion Receivables Invoice interface load job.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
